evals.prompt: Turn an existing four-hour session prep with a strong start, two routes, three encounter owners, a visible faction clock, and an off-map fallback into a DM-only run guide. Do not invent canon or write player-facing narration.
evals.expected_output: A cockpit run guide opens with Glance (stakes, strong start, danger, Silence, situation magnets, parachute). Each live beat is one linear cockpit: Now, narration, Ask, Be ready for, threat clock, zones, round script, roster embeds, landing payload. Combat owners are heading-embedded, not copied and not bare links.
expectations: Provides Glance with strong start, stakes, Silence, situation magnets, and parachute.
Uses world-state triggers rather than a mandatory player-choice sequence.
Each live card is one cockpit, not a dual Now/Run-now pair.
Includes the silence loop and does not fill silence with an invented beat or NPC monologue.

evals.prompt: Structural fixture: a session-prep inventory contains characters, scenes, locations, secrets, monsters, treasure, densify-sync notes, WIP status, and a multi-region archive dump. Render a run surface from it.
evals.expected_output: Fails the readability gate or refuses to treat the prep dump as a run guide; asks for a primary chronological run file and keeps archive/sync material out of the live surface.
expectations: Recognizes that prep inventory is not a run guide and points to rendering with run-guide.
Rejects densify/WIP/multi-region material in the run surface.
Requires one primary file and Glance → cockpit order instead of copying the dump.

evals.prompt: Structural fixture: given owner links for a strong start, three pressure states, two secrets, one revelation, location and NPC one-liners, a linked combat pack, a thin clock, and treasure, produce a DM-only run guide.
evals.expected_output: Passes when the output is one primary run file of linear cockpits: Glance, Now, narration callout, Ask, Be ready for table, threat clock, zones, round script, ![[Monster#Statblock]] embeds, landing payload. Dual header plus Run-now fails. Scene menu as prep-management fails. Bare [[Monster]] with no embed fails. Copied AC/HP tables fail.
expectations: Uses cockpit order, not Now/Say/Ask header followed by a second Run now block.
Keeps the strong start runnable alone and uses bullets and tables with no copied wiki essays.
Embeds combat owners with ![[Name#Statblock]]; does not copy stat numbers; does not require a Scene menu on a single-beat card.
Provides a landing payload and next-card trigger plus off-ramp after recompute.

evals.prompt: Render a DM-only run guide whose card inputs include telegram shorthand such as "field LR + watches; after LR ask if ate → warn".
evals.expected_output: Rewrites DM-facing card lines as complete grammatical sentences or short lists of complete sentences; rejects decoder-dependent shorthand.
expectations: Every DM-facing line is a complete grammatical sentence or a short list of complete sentences.
Rejects telegram shorthand, letter-code-only clauses, and slash-stacks that need a decoder.
Keeps open callouts and uses embeds or wikilinks for owners.

evals.prompt: Render the opening 30-minute aerial stoop as the sole-authority run card. Owners exist for Bloodhawk, Great Crown Squid, and Flying Boots. Independent scorers require no page-flip, no dual framework, a threat clock, zones, three player-facing tells, a Be ready for table, round-scripted hawks, and a landing payload.
evals.expected_output: One cockpit. Glance, Now once, narration with three squid-hunt tells, Ask not a menu, Be ready for table with skills and DCs, threat clock table, zone table, round script, ![[Bloodhawk#Statblock]] embed plus scene dials, landing callout with ^landing. No Scene menu, no second If ignored, no copied AC/HP.
expectations: Contains ![[Bloodhawk#Statblock]] or equivalent heading embed and does not retype AC, HP, or grab DC.
Contains one threat clock, named zones, and a Be ready for adjudication table (intention/approach), not Ask/offer as a closed menu.
Narration or Now includes three independent tells that she is hunting the squid.
Landing payload states wet/separated/hidden/sight-of-ship/where hawks and squid go.
No dual Run-now copy of the header; no Scene menu; no prep-workflow sentences.
